evidence: frontend/src/components/LabelPrint.tsx: retains label printing for users while exposing custom row and field controls only to Super Users and Privileged Administrators

backend/src/labels.ts: records the submitted print job and one navigable activity event for every included asset
backend/test/labels-contract.test.ts: verifies preview and audited print endpoints remain separate
frontend/src/components/LabelPrint.tsx: renders printable labels in a dedicated body-level print surface
